title: Metal plate
doc: The metal set: Poly Haven's metal_plate at 2K, colour, normal, roughness, metalness, ambient occlusion and a 16-bit height; the one sourced set with a metalness map, so the packed _ORM carries all three channels.

provenance.source: Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/a/metal_plate (CC0 1.0), fetched 2026-10-04 at 2K by tools/fetch_polyhaven.py; the set's LICENSE.md names the authors
provenance.note: base_color, base_metalness, specular_roughness, geometry_normal, ambient_occlusion, height: each binds the set's map of that name; base_color, base_metalness and specular_roughness carry the factor 1.0 because legacy v2 multiplies the sample by the factor and the family's constants would otherwise scale the maps
base_metalness factor 1.0 with the map, so the metalness map is seen as authored where the family's constant 1.0 would also pass; the map carries the plate's rust as dielectric
